info.name: Nissan Silvia S14
info.description: A dark and cinematic YouTube theme featuring a Nissan Silvia S14. The background should have a realistic JDM street-racing aesthetic with a black or dark grey S14, nighttime lighting, subtle neon reflections, and a clean automotive look. Keep the interface readable while making the S14 stand out in the background.
info.additionalInfo: Clean and sleek for a car guy...
